title: ANI Pharmaceuticals (ANIP) Appoints Henry Gosebruch To Its Board
summary: ANI Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGM: ANIP) appointed biotechnology executive Henry Gosebruch to its Board of Directors. Gosebruch previously held leadership roles at Lakefront Biotherapeutics, Neumora Therapeutics, and AbbVie. Board member Muthusamy (Samy) Shanmugam resigned from the Board and will continue in key operational roles at ANI Pharmaceuticals.
